name: Sill Line, Trued
tagline: The family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram, read question first: the box runs the board's width, and under it one Coming up rail carries the lit run from the now lamp to the tube's own stop, then the later plans as ink plates to a T buffer named All plans.
concept: Lit Sill Line had the tour's best soul and feedback and lost its points on placement. This refinement keeps every lit thing it had (the breathing now lamp, the lit run, the tube's power wire, the airglow, the scanlined Status glass, 'planning' in two layers) and moves them into reading order. Home is one board read top to bottom: her screen and the day, the box across the full width with the question as its label, then the sill zone, where the tube stands on the Coming up rail over its own stop, the station's name plate and its one count stand above the later stops, the plates hang below the sill and the rail ends at a buffer that says All plans. The same rules carry to every page: now is a lit lamp with a lit run or rule; ink is for plans and carries the plans' cyan cap; a pointed-at row lights a phosphor edge that fades over 1.2s. It should feel like a calm signal box at night where the question comes first and the week is laid out under it.
companions: Ink is the companion with a job, and it is kept for plans: a warmed blue-black #1a2230 plate with a #2a3646 edge and a 2px #70dcf4 cyan cap, on Coming up's plates, the Plans list's plan names and the month's plans. Nothing else is ink: the family's chat plates are the board's #161c20 slate with a 3px pale #86a9cc bar, and their fields are #0d141c wells with a #56708c edge. The board keeps steel: #58697a rails, #7d8fa0 buffers and drops, #a7c4d8 links and the #26313a latched cell for 'here'. Cyan #70dcf4 is only a plan's ring or cap, and the small ring in Lately added that says an idea is already on the calendar. Amber #ffb850 is only for what a person can act on: late words, the setup rings, the needed fields' words, and the half lamp of Sign-in, on Settings and on Status's glass and tally alike; on To do the late words stand beside a plain date in tabular figures. Sage #86d9a6 is the word 'now', a filled needed field and a done tick. The kind rings stay grounded: terracotta, moss and wheat. #6dff9c is lit only where something is live or being written: the mark, 'plan', Send, the box at rest and in use, focus rings (fields and selects alike), the now lamps with their runs and the NOW rules, the row afterglow's edge, a focused form field's stop, working lamps and the tubes.
decisions: Built as a clean sheet, as its parent was: today's stylesheet themed by the harness's theme.py from these tokens, then the lineage's sources in order (track.css, phosphor.css, relight.css, branch.css, sill.css) and this refinement's refine.css, by src/build.py. The ink constants were warmed in build.py itself, so every rule that names ink takes the new values.

Home, question first (system, interaction, the lessons' failed reach 3). The welcome board is now one grid with a separate .board-face behind its top four rows, so the plates under the sill hang from the very rail the board stands on. Row one is her screen, name and day; row two is the box across the board's full width with 'What are we planning?' inside its frame as the h1 label (Archivo 700 at 40px, 'planning' in E1's two layers). The tube cannot be read before the question any more, and the Tab order goes from the box to the ways to start before anything on the sill.

The sill zone, joined into one diagram. The now lamp breathes at the board's left edge on the rail, and the lit run (a white-hot core in the phosphor, with a head that runs along it on opening) goes all the way to stop one, which now sits under the tube's power lamp at the tube's right foot, so the tube's lit wire drops straight onto it and the whole occupied section, now to Next up, is lit (about 24rem). The vent grille went back to the chin's left. The next stop starts just past the tube's right edge (a 1.1rem gap), and the later plans share the rest of the rail equally, 1fr each, to a T buffer at the board's inner right edge. 'All plans →' is the buffer's own label, standing on the rail beside the bar, as setup's last step is. No rail runs empty.

Where I bent the brief: the ways to start sit in the glass beside the tube, top-aligned with it, rather than in a row of their own under the box. Under the box they left about 180px of empty glass, which the lineage's judges have called dead slate on every page; beside the tube they fill it and still read as the box's own keys, and now run to the same right edge as the plates. They are #1b242b slate keys with a 1px top highlight, 44px, sentence case, no outline. On a phone they are one row of compact keys that scrolls sideways, so Coming up is not pushed down.

Also bent: the station plate stands over the stops it names, its baselines shared ('Coming up' Archivo 600 20px, '4 coming · next Sunday 13:00' 14px ink-2), rather than above the now lamp, where it would have sat over the tube's top edge. It comes before the tube in the page's order, and on a phone it heads the line above the tube, where the brief put it.

Stops and plates: each day stays in the glass above the rail (30px Archivo 300, month in cyan over the weekday in 13px DM Sans, no longer mono). Each plate hangs on a 1px drop with its name in Archivo 600 15px at 92% width, at most two lines; 'text-wrap: pretty' rather than 'balance', because balance broke 'Mount St. / Helens day trip'. The foot line is pinned to the plate's bottom: '09:00' in DM Mono, 'in 7 days' in DM Sans (type's fix).

Airglow: it rises off the lit run only, masked to the lower left of the board and widened to follow the longer run (radial 30% by 100% at 15% 100%), with E7's scanline whisper inside it, plus a 10% pool in the board's lower left corner. The box keeps its E4 resting halo, and nothing else on the board glows. Under more contrast the airglow and the spill go.

Ink: warmed to #1a2230 with a #2a3646 edge, and each plan plate is capped in the plans' 2px cyan, so a plan is told from anything else at a glance. The pale #86a9cc cap is gone from plates. Ink is used only for plans (Coming up, the Plans list, the month). Chat's family plates are #161c20 slate with the 3px #86a9cc bar, and their names are set in it: no navy in Chat (skeptic).

Setup: only the action phrase is the link and is underlined ('Choose your own password'); the rest of the clause is ink-2 and unlinked. An invisible overlay keeps the whole step a 44px target. 'Next step' is DM Sans 600 at the 13px label step, in sage with a soft bloom, not mono.

To do, on Home and on its page: NOW is a full-row 1px lit rule (Trued's), its glow drawn as a box-shadow so the 'now' word in sage on the rail stays sharp. Each deadline now says its day as the calendar names it, 'Sun 27 Sep', in DM Sans tabular figures: on Home it is the margin's stamp, right-aligned, with 'was due 5 days ago' in amber under the title; on the To do page it is right-aligned at the row's end with the amber words beside it. The lone 'Due' head over Home's margin is gone. In the app the date is a small field task_brief and task_row pass (task_row already has the due date); for this render Home's copy works it out from today and the relative words, and the page's from the due date it has. 'Edit' is quiet underlined text with a 44px hit area and no box.

Row afterglow (E9, soul and the lessons): pointing at or focusing a row on Home, Ideas, To do, Status and Settings lights a 2px #6dff9c inset edge with a 10% green wash, a 26px inner glow and a 12px outer bloom, in 0.12s, fading over 1.2s on cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.75, 0.55), which holds the light early. Sampled off motion-glow: the edge is (117,253,153) on hover, (109,252,153) at 120ms and (99,231,143) at 380ms, and it is gone by 900ms. The plates on the sill take the same edge.

Status, one instrument in one bezel, now as wide as the column (glass 1fr, the case's label plate 19rem), so no slate is left beside it. The glass's lamps spread along their strings. The label plate carries the tally as big bone numerals stacked (5 working, 1 waiting, 1 needs a look, 2 off, 4 not set up), with 'Change the limit' under it; a state nobody is in is not drawn, and the waiting lamp is the steel ring with a dot that waiting is everywhere else. Each lamp on the glass is named under it in VT323 at the tube's dim strength, at 14px rather than the brief's 11px, which would be under the tour's 13px floor.

'This page' is an amber half lamp, on the glass, on the Connected board and in the tally, while the family still shares a password: the same check Settings uses to say Sign-in needs a look. A lamp no longer says more than the words beside it (the lessons' 'lamp that lies').

Chat: the head is 48px with a one-line lede, the thread is tighter (0.55rem between turns), and the box and Send are on the first screen at 1280 by 900. Only her newest stop is lit: her screen's halo, its time in sage with a soft bloom and the bubble's edge in the phosphor. Her older bubbles and screens are matte. I found and fixed a class collision on the way: the parent's '.station' would have been shared by Home's name plate and the chat line's station.

Ideas: the drive is set as figures and units, the figures DM Sans 650 in bone and the units 13px in the label colour ('2 h 10 min'), right-aligned so 'min' stacks. A separate Way column holds S, SE and so on. The head is 'No.' over bare numerals, with no '#'. Lighting a stop on the line from home now also answers :active (a tap), beside :hover and :focus-within.

Plans: the month opens on the week that holds today. Any weeks gone by before it fold into one 32px strip with a dashed steel run ('31 Aug – 27 Sep · nothing on', or the plans gone by with a link to the list); it is not in this render (2 October is in the month's first week), so I checked it by eye on a copy of the template forced to fold two weeks. The head says one count, of what the month itself shows ('4 more this month', next Sun 4 Oct 13:00). The lit run stays on today's week. A class collision was fixed: Home's .stop rule had made the month's stop cell a flex box, which is why the weekend shading stopped short under the Oaks Park plate; it is a table cell again and the shading fills the row.

Form: a 2px rail runs down the label edge with a stop at every field, 'Everything else' included, and ends at a buffer beside Add it. The stop of the field being written in lights in #6dff9c with E21's small halo. Required fields say 'needed' in amber words under their label, and the word and the stop turn sage once the field holds something. Selects take the same 2px #6dff9c focus ring as fields.

Phone: the tube's date is set short ('Sun 4 Oct 13:00 · in 2 days') across the tube's width on one line, with the 4.5rem scope beside '> 3 more on the line', so there is no foot band and no empty glass. 'now' sits on the rail's own line beside its lamp. The ways to start are one sideways row, 'Send where I am' has a 44px row, Send shows its word, and the rail runs down the left gutter from the now lamp through the tube's wire and on past the board's foot beside the plates to the buffer.

Typesetting: Archivo is the head face throughout ('What's our plan?' 700 at 80% width, 'Coming up' 600 at 90%, the plate names 600 at 92%); figures are tabular and lining wherever they line up (stop days, tally, drive, No., the To do dates); DM Mono is kept for clock times only, and 'now' moved to the sans like every other word. The tube's line from home on Ideas uses the table's convention ('No. 7 · Pumpkin patch at Bi-Mart farm · 18 min'). The thread's measure is capped at 60ch with 'pretty' wrapping.
title: What's our *plan*? Changed from the parent's 'What are we planning?', because every lens in round 2 that ranked titles put 'What's our plan?' ahead of it: the -ing form read as a status check rather than an invitation, and an 8-letter lit word was heavy under E1's two layers. 'What's our plan?' is the family's own voice ('our'), asks to be told something, says FamilyDB's job in one word (the planner: weekends, ideas, the calendar, things to do), fits one line on a phone at about 29px, and its four-letter key word carries a cleaner halo. The sill under the box answers it: the plans are laid out on the line just below.
strengths: The question is read first, on desktop and phone, and is the largest thing on Home: 'What's our plan?' inside the box's frame, 'plan' in two layers.

Home's sill is one diagram: the now lamp, a lit run all the way to the tube's own stop under its power lamp, the later plans running on from the tube's edge as ink plates, 1fr each, to a buffer named All plans at the board's edge. No dead track.
The light is where attention belongs: the breathing lamp, the lit run with its white-hot core, the tube's wire, the airglow off the run, and the key word.

One grammar holds on every page. Now is a lit lamp with a lit run or rule (Home's sill, To do's full-width NOW, the month's week, the form's focused stop). Plans are ink under a cyan cap. Amber is only for what a person can act on.
To do says when, both ways: the day as the calendar names it in tabular figures, and the amber 'was due 5 days ago' beside it.
Status is one instrument across the column: named lamps on the glass, the tally on the case's label plate in the glass's own lamp language.
The row afterglow (2px phosphor edge, 10% wash) answers pointer, focus and the keyboard on Home, Ideas, To do, Status, Settings and the plates, and lights the idea's stop on the line from home.
No target under 44px on Home at either width.
weaknesses: It is still a line-heavy design. A judge who reads rails as a subway map will find one on Home, To do, the month, the form, Status's chain and Chat.
Home's sill zone still has about 100px of empty glass between the ways to start and 'Coming up', because the tube is taller than the days and their name plate.
Two deliberate departures from the brief remain: the ways to start sit beside the tube, not under the box, and the station plate stands over the later stops, not above the now lamp.
The lit run is now long (about 24rem) to reach the tube's own stop. It is one 2px line with its airglow, but a judge wary of glare may find the lower left of the board brighter than the parent's.
The ink plates are warmer but still a blue-black; beside the green some may read them as navy, though they are kept to plans and carry the cyan cap.

Some values are still worked out in the templates: the lamp states and short lamp names, the drive's figures and way, the month's count and fold, Coming up's 'next Sunday 13:00', and now Home's absolute due date (from today and the relative words; the To do page's comes from the real due date). Each should become a small field in views.py when it ships.
Status's glass is wider than its contents now; the spend readout's upper right is empty glass.
The page's words move: Ideas differs from today by about a third, Home by about a sixth (the station count, the title, the dates, 'needed' on the form, the lamp names on Status).
